declared_exclusions.item: after-read 5 exercised through the API edge rather than on the deployed bytes
declared_exclusions.reason: AMENDMENT 1 directs pass-2 step 5 to read through the deployed bytes with no token minted, and the order's bounds forbid a write to the auth plane, so no authenticated request was issued. The read therefore proves the function's own decision -- which IB67-1 names as the decision that matters -- and does NOT exercise CloudFront, the Lambda@Edge validator or the gateway authorizer.
